brief.headline: Azov tanker campaign rattles Kremlin bloggers; FSB touts Rostov drone-plot bust
brief.lead: The dominant strain today was Ukraine's sustained drone campaign on fuel logistics in the Azov Sea and Rostov region, which pushed channel sentiment on Ukrainian strikes sharply negative even as bloggers amplified an FSB claim of a foiled AI-drone plot on a Rostov airfield. Tone was split: upbeat on Russian strikes and frontline gains, defensive and irritated on tankers and refinery damage.

developments.title: Fifth day of Ukrainian drone strikes on Azov tankers
developments.body: Two Majors ran multiple posts describing a persisting Azov Sea campaign against Russian tankers, claiming a fifth consecutive day of attacks and citing a fuel-logistics problem; one post claimed Russia intercepted 376 drones while Ukraine allegedly hit 14 tankers. WarGonzo said a Turkish tanker was struck. All figures are channel/MoD-sourced and unverified.

developments.title: Bloggers push back on Ukrainian tanker-kill claims
developments.body: NgP raZVedka disputed Ukrainian claims of 49 destroyed tankers as propaganda, arguing drone damage to ships is hard to verify — a rare positive-coded post in an otherwise negative topic, signaling damage-control messaging around the losses.

developments.title: FSB claims foiled AI-drone plot on Rostov airfield
developments.body: Rybar, Kotsnews, Poddubny and WarGonzo amplified an FSB claim of a thwarted alleged GUR plot using 13 AI-equipped FPV drones against a Rostov airfield, with one version saying a Russian citizen voluntarily reported it. MoD/FSB-sourced and unconfirmed.

developments.title: Claimed Russian strikes on Ukrainian fuel infrastructure
developments.body: Channels claimed wide strikes on Ukrainian fuel and energy targets, with Rybar asserting 93 Ukrainian gas stations hit in early July and strikes across nine regions per WarGonzo. Two Majors framed it as mutual refinery/fuel warfare. Claims are channel-sourced.

developments.title: Frontline claims: gains near Pokrovsk offset by admitted setback
developments.body: Bloggers claimed consolidation in Konstantinovka and a planned Dobropillya encirclement, but Rybar acknowledged Ukrainian forces recaptured Ivanovka and pushed back Russian positions near Novopavlovka — a rare negative frontline admission.

developments.title: Western aid items flagged: ATACMS in Germany, Polish MiGs
developments.body: Two Majors highlighted Lockheed Martin/Rheinmetall plans to produce ATACMS in Germany from 2027 and UK K3 Scout naval drones; Poddubny cited Poland negotiating up to nine MiG-29s for Ukraine in exchange for drone tech. Reported claims, unverified.

narrative_watch.title: Ukrainian mobilization framed as regime brutality
narrative_watch.body: Kotsnews and Poddubny repeated a claim of 620 forced-mobilization incidents over two years and 'public humiliation' of Lviv protesters, framing Ukrainian conscription as violent and illegitimate.

narrative_watch.title: Ukraine-as-terrorist-state framing
narrative_watch.body: Poddubny alleged 'terrorist battalions trained in ISIS camps' near Druzhkovka and Rybar framed Ukrainian operatives as expendable agents, sustaining the terrorism-labeling narrative.

narrative_watch.title: Self-critical 'honesty' essay circulates
narrative_watch.body: Starshe Eddy and Rybar amplified an essay urging Russia to acknowledge war problems honestly, citing Soviet WWII transparency — an unusual introspective frame worth tracking.

mood_lines.text: Still deeply negative (net -75) but improved 25 points as bloggers pivot to disputing tanker-kill counts and touting the foiled Rostov plot.

flag_texts.title: Ukraine strikes on Russia rebounds 25 points
flag_texts.body: Sentiment stayed sharply negative (net -75) amid a fifth day of Azov tanker attacks and Rostov drone strikes, but improved as channels reframed losses via NgP raZVedka's dispute of Ukrainian tanker-kill claims and the FSB plot bust.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO up 26 points to net -18
flag_texts.body: Alarm at Western aid (ATACMS in Germany, Polish MiG-29s, UK naval drones) was partly offset by positive posts on China's reusable-rocket landing, Russian oil gains from Iran-US tension, and a claimed Russia-China anti-Starlink plan.

flag_texts.title: Russia internal cools 39 points
flag_texts.body: Despite an upbeat FSB counter-terror narrative around the Rostov airfield plot, net sentiment fell to +38 as introspective essays on wartime honesty and lists of 'absurd' administrative fines added neutral-to-negative tone.

flag_texts.title: Mobilization rumours and Putin criticism silent
flag_texts.body: No posts touched domestic mobilization rumours or direct criticism of Putin; all mobilization content targeted Ukraine, and internal criticism was confined to bureaucratic fines rather than leadership.
